scenarios.prompt: Using repo-kickstart, give me the ordered steps to set up the codebase-memory-mcp structure graph for a fictional TypeScript repository named acme/widget, which has committed node_modules/ and dist/ trees and no graph yet. Do not run any commands and do not create any files, banks or indexes; answer in text only. Include each command or tool call I should run and how I prove each step worked.
scenarios.assert:
L=$(tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < result.txt | tr '
' ' ') && C=$(printf '%s
' "$L" | awk '{print index($0, ".cbmignore")}') && P=$(printf '%s
' "$L" | awk '{print index($0, "persistence")}') && [ "$C" -gt 0 ] && [ "$P" -gt "$C" ] && printf '%s' "$L" | grep -qE 'merge: ours|check-attr'
scenarios.note: Rule under test: .cbmignore is written before the first indexing, indexing uses persistence=true, and git check-attr merge -- .codebase-memory/graph.db.zst must print merge: ours. The check lowercases the answer and passes when .cbmignore appears, persistence appears after it, and the answer contains 'merge: ours' or 'check-attr'. It anchors on persistence rather than on the word 'index' because the skill's own preflight compares root_path before index_repository, ahead of the .cbmignore step. Known limits: it accepts an answer that names persistence after .cbmignore in some other sense, it does not check that the artifact is committed, and it accepts check-attr without the merge: ours output. Measured 2026-11-26. Both arms started from an empty directory with the installed huhhb@huhhb plugin switched off and no MCP servers (--strict-mcp-config); the skill arm loaded a git archive copy of the branch with --plugin-dir. The baseline arm also ran with no built-in tools (--tools ""): with tools, a baseline run read skills/repo-kickstart from a worktree on disk and from the installed plugin cache (docs/MISTAKES.md 4.1). Three clean baseline runs before the bench all failed this check; none named .cbmignore, merge: ours, check-attr or persistence. Dropped before the bench: ruleset-first-protection (rulesets endpoint before classic protection, no classic PUT). Its three clean baseline runs passed 2 of 3, so the model already follows that rule without the skill (docs/LESSONS.md L-003).
